text: タカと　いっしょに　しょうぶ　したいの！

structure.jp: タカと　いっしょに
しょうぶ　したいの！

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb says the speaker wants to do it. しょうぶ　したい = 'I want to battle'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives an explaining, insisting tone, here in a girlish way. したいの = 'I want to, you see!'.

patterns.name: 〜といっしょに
patterns.span: タカと　いっしょに
patterns.explanation: と with いっしょに says who you do something with. タカと　いっしょに = 'together with Jon'.
